sloka: अन्येभ्यो हि त्वया रक्ष्या प्राप्नुयां धर्षणं यदि ।तद्धर्मतः स्नुषा ते ऽहं तत्त्वमेव ब्रवीमि ते ।। ७.२६.३० ॥
transliteration: anyebhyo hi tvayā rakṣyā prāpnuyāṁ dharṣaṇaṁ yadi ।taddharmataḥ snuṣā te 'haṁ tattvameva bravīmi te ।। 7.26.30 ॥

translations.english: You are indeed the one who should protect me from molestation by others, and by dharma, I am your daughter-in-law; I tell you this truth.
